scope: Original authored presets; not trained artist models or reference audio.

bass.label: Bass Playground
bass.description: Heavy bass, playful contrasts, space before the drop.
bass.genre: bass music with half-time and broken-beat sections
bass.character: Original evolving bass timbres, punchy drums, rhythmic call and response, short contrasting sections and deliberate space before bass returns. No artist imitation.

house.label: Club Flow
house.description: A locked house groove and smooth bass handoffs.
house.character: Tight kick and bass, crisp hats and warm chord stabs.

afro-house.label: Organic Afro House
afro-house.description: A soulful club groove with moving bass and layered organic percussion.
afro-house.character: Steady four-on-the-floor kick; deep rounded bass that answers rather than doubles the kick; syncopated hand drums, shakers, rims, claps and toms; warm restrained pads and original melodic hooks. Develop the groove in phrases with fills, breaks and satisfying returns. No artist imitation or borrowed melodies.

peak-time.label: Peak Time
peak-time.description: Driving club drums, strong momentum, short builds.
peak-time.character: Driving four-on-the-floor drums, tight bass, percussive hooks, short builds and strong bass returns. Maintain dancefloor momentum without long silent breakdowns.

hip-hop.label: Hip-hop
hip-hop.description: Swung drums, bass pockets and room for hooks.
hip-hop.character: Original swung kick and snare patterns, a deep bass pocket, sparse melodic motifs, rhythmic variation and room for brief original hooks. No borrowed samples or artist imitation.

chill.label: Chill & Groove
chill.description: Relaxed drums, warm chords and longer blends.
chill.character: Soft swung drums, warm original jazz chords, mellow bass and unhurried melodic development. Consistent gentle rhythm, restrained fills and smooth instrumental edges; no festival drops or sampled recordings.

tech-house.label: Tech House
tech-house.description: Dry drums, rolling bass and sparse hooks.
tech-house.character: Dry punchy drums, rolling bass and sparse percussive hooks.

techno.label: Techno
techno.description: A steady pulse and evolving rhythmic synths.
techno.character: Driving kick, pulsing low bass and evolving rhythmic synths.
